miguel: Heads-up: small EU canary (split-traffic A/B) Tue 10:00 UTC. Model variant: v8.1.0-quantA (primary) with fallback v8.0.4. Need a short internal RN and an ops checklist. @tara @kevin can you help?
tara: I can draft the blurb. Quick Q: what's the circuit-breaker thresholds and the embargo?
miguel: Circuit-breaker: pause if error rate >0.6% for 2m OR p95 >170ms for 5m. Hard rollback: error >1.0% sustained 3m OR eval drift >2.5%. Embargo until 11:15 UTC.
kevin: Rollback path: deploy-bot will pin to v8.0.4, drain new canaries, then scale down and open an incident stub. We'll also run the quick regressions in the eval repo.
deploy-bot: queued by @miguel job id db-80088. Command:
```
/deploy canary --model v8.1.0-quantA --region eu --split 10,50 --window 30m --notify #eng-oncall
```
oncall_emma: I'll own 09:45-12:00 UTC. I'll run smoke at T+4 and T+18, and the eval harness at T+10. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-ab-split
tara: Draft blurb (short):
"INTERNAL: EU canary A/B for v8.1.0-quantA  Tue 10:00 UTC. Owner: @oncall_emma. Fallback: v8.0.4. Targets: p95 <150ms, errors <0.5%. Embargo until 11:15 UTC. On circuit-breaker -> automatic pause; on hard breach -> immediate pin & rollback. See dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-ab-split"
kevin: tiny edits: change p95 target to <160ms and note deploy-bot will also trigger a smoke-eval run before moving to 50% split.
tara: done. approvals?
miguel: +1
oncall_emma: +1 :thumbsup: I'll also post a short status message in #incidents if any gating fires.
miguel: I'll pin this in #eng-releases 12min before and paste into #internal-announce 10min prior. deploy-bot, set job db-80088 to ready.
deploy-bot: job db-80088 -> ready. Will emit start/pause/complete events and can auto-pin on command. :robot_face:
ops-bot: Preflight check passed: smoke scripts uploaded, alerts wired, rate limits validated. Runbook for rollback: https://runbook.company/redwood/rollback-quick. If legal hold needed for EU data path, notify privacy.
